rachel: Quick Q  assessors requested KMS decrypt access for a small set of keys to validate model artifacts. Can we handle this without giving them direct decrypt?
devin: We should avoid direct decrypt. Plan: create a 'decrypt-proxy' that runs in a tightly guarded VPC and only returns an HMAC of the plaintext plus an audit blob. If assessor needs plaintext, they request via sec-ops and we run a recorded session.
sam: Agree. Proxy auth: require session tag assessment=true and a one-time ephemeral token minted by SEC service. Proxy logs go to encrypted S3 and are included in evidence bundle.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-9991 "KMS decrypt proxy design for assessors" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9991
infra-oncall: Also note: we'll apply a condition in the key policy: "StringEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/assessment":"true"} and deny decrypt otherwise. Keep key rotation disabled for the window.
rachel: Who will own the documented flow for assessors to request decrypts? I can draft the runbook but need a review from devin.
devin: I'll review. Also include a checklist: 1) Key policy snapshot, 2) Proxy code bundle (sha256), 3) IAM role ARNs, 4) CloudTrail export + hash.
sam: Add monitoring: alert if decrypt proxy is called > 5 times in an hour. Escalate to sec-ops and eng-oncall.
rachel: Ok I'll draft and post into SEC-9991. Tagging @devin for review. Thanks.
